description: INDIA bloc parties have formally petitioned the Chief Justice of India regarding the Election Commission's special intensive revision of electoral rolls and other election-related concerns. This joint letter, signed by 23 parties and an independent, follows a recent opposition meeting where consensus was reached on key issues. The alliance emphasized solidarity and resistance, aiming to address perceived electoral irregularities and demanding the Education Minister's resignation over examination controversies.
title: 'Committed to SURE': 23 opposition parties write to CJI over EC's SIR process

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: 'Will cut off those hands': Pakistan minister issues threat to India over Indus Waters Treaty

author: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY AND SHALABH
description: Ayodhya police have intensified their probe into alleged embezzlement of Ram Temple donations, recording statements from former Trust general secretary Champat Rai and other functionaries. Investigators are meticulously examining the entire donation management process, from receipt to deposit, to identify procedural lapses and establish accountability. This crucial step aims to reconstruct the movement of funds and uncover any conspiracy, with financial records and evidence being corroborated.
title: How Ram Temple donations were received, counted & deposited: Cops quiz Champat Rai

author: TNN
description: A 26-year-old physiotherapist was discovered deceased in a locked room at a homestay near Nandi Hills, with her boyfriend found unconscious beside her. Police are investigating a suspected murder-suicide attempt. The victim's mother has filed a complaint alleging a 'love jihad' angle, leading to a murder case against the boyfriend.
title: Bengaluru physiotherapist found dead at homestay in Nandi Hills; boyfriend unconscious

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Sachin Tendulkar led heartfelt tributes to Ben Stokes following his retirement from international cricket. Tendulkar lauded Stokes' fearless approach, match-winning ability, and inspirational leadership, calling him one of England's finest all-rounders and captains. Stokes, who bowed out after a Test series loss, expressed contentment with his decision, citing years of physical and mental demands as the primary reason for stepping away.
title: 'Staying away will be the hardest': Tendulkar's message to Stokes after retirement

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In an extraordinary twist of fate, 73-year-old Gill Thompson reunited with her long-lost half-brother, Michael Bardsley, using the unlikeliest of tools—LinkedIn. After years of yearning for connection, their heartfelt journey unfolded through video calls, leading to Michael's touching visit to Wales, where the siblings shared an emotional embrace, rediscovering a bond woven from years of untold family stories.
title: Lost brother, found on LinkedIn: 73-YO grandma finds long-lost sibling!

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Stock market recommendations: JSW Energy, Biocon, BHEL, and City Union Bank - these are the top stocks to buy recommended by Somil Mehta, Head of Retail Research at Mirae Asset Sharekhan for June 30, 2026:
title: Top stocks to buy: Stock market recommendations for today - check list

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: The Supreme Court has significantly curbed the use of 'geofence warrants' by law enforcement, deeming them a violation of Fourth Amendment privacy rights. This ruling restricts police from accessing vast location data from tech companies to identify individuals near crime scenes. The court emphasized that automated tracking of millions, even with data held by third parties, requires constitutional safeguards against unreasonable searches, impacting a tool widely used by detectives.
title: US Supreme Court restricts geofence warrants after Google case; what are they

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: A major ransomware attack on Tata Electronics has exposed sensitive Apple supply chain data, including details of upcoming iPhone 18 Pro models and component suppliers, on the dark web. This breach, attributed to the World Leaks group, could significantly impact Apple's global manufacturing strategy and its growing partnership with Tata in India. Apple is reportedly investigating the incident.
title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro data leak: Tata Electronics breach exposes key components

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Ajay Rai, the Congress chief in Uttar Pradesh, has accused the BJP government of placing him under house arrest to stop a party delegation from reaching the revered Ram Temple in Ayodhya. He suggested that the government is anxious about a potential backlash from devotees regarding a donation embezzlement scandal. Rai's wife voiced her concerns, stating that the BJP would be accountable for any harm that might come to him.
title: 'Afraid of Ram devotees coming?' Congress claims leaders under house arrest ahead of Ayodhya visit

author: SUMAN MANDAL
description: A significant fire erupted at the Haldia Refinery in West Bengal early Tuesday morning, engulfing a naphtha-carrying pipeline. Several workers sustained burn injuries and were promptly taken for medical attention. The exact cause of the blaze remains under investigation. Details regarding the full extent of the damage and the condition of those injured are still emerging.
title: Massive fire breaks out at Bengal's Haldia refinery, several workers injured

author: ABHINAV RAJPUT
description: Delhi's new EV policy, effective July 1, prioritizes pure electric vehicles, excluding hybrids. It offers substantial road tax and registration fee exemptions for electric cars under Rs 30 lakh, alongside a Rs 1 lakh incentive for scrapping old cars to buy new EVs. Subsidies are also available for electric two and three-wheelers, aiming to significantly curb pollution and boost clean mobility.
title: Delhi EV policy keeps hybrids out, includes 3-year lock-in period

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Wimbledon witnessed a heartwarming moment as Novak Djokovic invited himself to a fan's wedding after a proposal on Centre Court. Meanwhile, Naomi Osaka turned heads with a striking Kill Bill-inspired kimono, a creative nod to her Japanese heritage amidst the strict dress code. Both athletes delivered memorable off-court performances alongside their on-court victories.
title: Watch: Djokovic seeks wedding invite from fan; Osaka stuns with 'Kill Bill' entrance

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Oil prices dipped as markets weighed potential US-Iran talks in Doha against ongoing regional instability. Despite recent missile exchanges and attacks on ships, crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz have seen an uptick. Investors are cautiously optimistic about diplomatic efforts, though tangible signs of de-escalation remain elusive. Analysts suggest Gulf oil flows are steadily recovering, potentially returning to pre-conflict levels soon.
title: Oil prices ease as investors await US-Iran talks; Brent crude falls to $72 per barrel

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Tragedy struck northern Germany Monday as a gunman killed at least six people at a youth welfare facility in Stade. All victims were employees. Officials suspect a custody dispute fueled the 'extremely violent crime committed in cold blood.' The main suspect is arrested, with two others facing police scrutiny. The incident, which left several injured, has prompted a high-pressure investigation into the motive and events.
title: 6 dead after gunman opens fire at youth welfare centre in custody dispute in Germany

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Germany’s long-standing reputation as World Cup penalty shootout specialists came to an end as Paraguay defeated them 4–3 on penalties after a 1–1 draw in Boston. It was Germany’s first-ever shootout loss, ending a 44-year perfect record dating back to 1982. Despite dominance in possession, missed penalties proved decisive, while Paraguay maintained their flawless shootout record.
title: Paraguay end Germany's 44-year World Cup streak as football giants crash out

author: SHALABH
description: The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust has advanced its meeting to July 6, where the resignations of General Secretary Champat Rai and member Anil Mishra are expected to be finalized. The Trust may also discuss operational restructuring for enhanced transparency and consider new members. Discussions will also cover improving visitor facilities, especially during extreme heat, and crowd management strategies.
title: Ram Temple trust to hold key meet 5 days early, to decide Champat Rai's fate on July 6

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal were recently spotted enjoying a family dinner in Mumbai, accompanied by Sonakshi's parents, veteran actor Shatrughan Sinha and Poonam Sinha, along with Zaheer's father, Iqbal Ratansi. The family's warm outing caught the attention of paparazzi, with one heartfelt moment particularly winning over fans.
title: Sonakshi and Zaheer enjoy family dinner with Shatrughan Sinha, Poonam Sinha

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: The Dallas Cowboys have been named a potential landing spot for Indianapolis Colts star Jonathan Taylor in a proposed trade. CBS Sports' Garrett Podell suggested the All-Pro running back could be available for a third-round pick if the Colts struggle in 2026. With Taylor entering the final year of his contract and coming off another standout season, Dallas could pursue him if its rushing attack fails to meet expectations.
title: Cowboys linked to $53M Colts star in blockbuster NFL trade proposal

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor expressed enthusiasm for Prime Minister Narendra Modi's potential return visit to the United States, highlighting President Trump's continued engagement with India. Gor is optimistic about finalizing an interim trade agreement soon, noting the complex negotiations involving thousands of items. He also indicated a likely visit by President Trump to India next year, following PM Modi's attendance at the G20 Summit in Miami.
title: 'Love to have him back': Gor on PM Modi's US invite, hints Trump likely to visit India next year

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Paraguay produced a stunning World Cup shock in Boston, beating Germany 4-3 on penalties after a 1-1 draw that they largely survived under relentless pressure. Germany dominated possession, chances and territory for 120 minutes but lacked cutting edge, while Orlando Gill’s heroics and Paraguay’s deep defensive resilience kept them alive. It ends Germany’s first-ever World Cup shootout defeat.
title: Paraguay reach Round of 16 after Germany’s first-ever World Cup shootout defeat

author: TOI
title: We will hit back: New TNCC chief Tagore sets sight on PM Rahul Gandhi for 2029
